item.mng: eke ayaq-γ-a tegimlig-ün anggida nomoγadqaqui-yin teyin büged ilγaγči

item.coloph: khaçi ubadini phaṭa ña deu-a kiged dima kar-a ba, enedkeg-ün ubadini vidy-a kar-a biraba kiged, kelemürči / bandida čoγ ǰibqulang-tu ber orčiγulǰu, enedkeg-ün ubadini vidy-a kar-a barava kiged öčgči kemürči bandi ḓbang / brçeg ber nayiraγulǰu orosiγulbai, kunga odser mañǰusiri mergen bandida gui si-tur dulduyidču um ǰ"id lam-a orčiγulbai.
